title: Community Painting Unveiling
paragraphs: Guild Artist Member Elaine Felos Ostrander assists during the puzzle painting event
The Guild of Harwich Artists will unveil the Mystery Painting Puzzle on Saturday, June 29 4:30 PM, at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Welcome Center in Harwich Port.

The project created May 4th was part of the ArtWeek 2019 events taking place state-wide. Hosted by the Guild at the Harwich Cultural Center, the day-long project involved community residents, mentored by Guild artists, painting a 6″x 6″ canvas panel of a small portion of a mystery image. When combined the 96 panels create an engaging image of an iconic Harwich scene.
If you can not join us for the unveiling, the Puzzle will remain hanging for the season for all to see and enjoy. Thanks to all involved!

bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder June 27, 2019

The Guild of Harwich Artists will unveil the Mystery Painting Puzzle on Saturday, June 29 4:30 PM, at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Welcome Center in Harwich Port. 

The project created May 4th was part of the ArtWeek 2019 events taking place state-wide.  Hosted by the Guild at the Harwich Cultural Center, the day-long project involved community residents, mentored by Guild artists, painting a 6″x 6″ canvas panel of a small portion of a mystery image. When combined the 96 panels create an engaging image of an iconic Harwich scene.

If you can not join us for the unveiling, the Puzzle will remain hanging for the season for all to see and enjoy.  Thanks to all involved!
